args: $deadline=(Get-Date).AddSeconds(45); $ok=$false; while((Get-Date) -lt $deadline){ try{ $r=Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'http://localhost:5210/health' -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 2; if($r.StatusCode -eq 200){ $ok=$true; break } }catch{}; Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 750 }; if(-not $ok){ Write-Error 'Backend chua san sang tai http://localhost:5210/health trong 45s. Kiem tra Debug Console cua CalTrack: Backend (vi du port 5210 dang ban hoac thieu Jwt:Key user-secret).'; exit 1 }; Write-Host 'Backend ready: HTTP 200 tai http://localhost:5210/health.'
